reasons: Cited Section 24 satisfies the preferred position: 24.1 gives Customer consent-free assignment to Affiliates and M&A successors (notice only), 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment/change-of-control transfer to Customer consent not unreasonably withheld and bars assignment to a Customer competitor, and 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any termination, suspension, repricing, or service-reduction right on Customer's change of control.
Compliant claim is correctly accompanied by no redline and no counterparty comment; rendered paragraphs are unchanged from the originals.
Deterministic check confirms the successor/affiliate carve-out is present; no walk-away triggers (blanket Customer assignment ban or Vendor CoC exit/re-price right) appear in the cited text.
